sections.title: Overview
descriptions: This page brings together available employment and compensation records related to Quinn Jay Adamson. It also contains details of his involvement in multiple police encounters.

sections.title: Employment
descriptions: Officer Quinn Jay Adamson began working for the American Fork Police Department on June 8, 2010. He was employed by the Provo City Constable’s Office from September 29, 2017, through October 11, 2018.

sections.title: Related Police Encounters
descriptions: Sergeant Quinn J. Adamson was involved in the April 17, 2020, encounter with Cody Greenland and was named as a defendant in Greenland’s federal civil-rights lawsuit. The complaint alleged that Adamson tased Greenland multiple times without warning while officers had him pinned to the ground. The case was later settled for an unspecified amount and dismissed with prejudice.

Lieutenant Quinn J. Adamson was also involved in the Reckless Ben matter. Available records identify him as the lieutenant positioned on the perimeter during the search and as the officer who interrupted Benjamin Schneider’s recording and took possession of the recording device.
